scores.evidence: Depends on: Phase 1. ACLs protect content, so content must already be durable.
scores.rationale: Each phase names its dependencies and starts from a proven substrate (sync, durability, fuzz harness) before features that build on it.

scores.evidence: A CI pipeline builds one container image. It deploys to staging, then the same image is promoted to prod.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a thin end-to-end slice through CDN, LB, api, collab and Postgres, running in prod with an explicit exit check.

scores.evidence: Switch to OT (ShareDB-style, server-ordered) if CRDT tombstone or memory overhead goes over budget (for example, more than 50 MB...
scores.rationale: Many irreversible decisions are listed up front with a default and a concrete flip condition.

scores.evidence: Freeze the stored data format... This is the widest-impact task because every document ever written depends on it.
scores.rationale: Within phases, wide-impact tasks come first and leaf work (toolbar, typing indicators, reactions, export) is explicitly last.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: OIDC login. Short-lived JWT checked on WebSocket upgrade. TLS everywhere. Secrets in a managed store. Dependency scanning in CI.
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security treatment in every phase from Phase 0.

scores.evidence: OTel trace from client send to broadcast. Metrics for connections, append p99, ack RTT. Logs contain IDs only. One dashboard and one alert.
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and each later phase has specific metrics.

scores.evidence: Lockfile monorepo. One image promoted from staging to prod. Terraform. Versioned migrations.
scores.rationale: Reproducibility has concrete items in every phase, such as deterministic fuzz seeds, log replay, pinned renderers and index rebuilds.

scores.evidence: Client reconnect with exponential backoff and jitter. Managed Postgres with point-in-time recovery. Health checks. One-command rollback
scores.rationale: Failure handling is specific in every phase, from Phase 0 through load shedding in Phase 7.

scores.evidence: N/A. The system has no AI or agentic capability, so prompt-injection defense, model budgets, retrieval and the rest don't apply.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Tables, images and embeds... Pull forward once the rich-text fuzz run has been clean for 4 weeks and users ask for them.
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed with reasons and concrete pull-forward conditions.

note: Very strong plan: it has a real prod skeleton, gates with flip conditions, and concrete per-phase cross-cutting treatment. It declares the AI layer N/A, and I found no significant gaps.
